h1: Fractional CO2 laser resurfacing in Cairo
answer: Fractional CO2 laser treats small columns of skin during resurfacing. Adults with selected scars, uneven texture or stretch marks can discuss FineXel at {{brand}} in New Cairo and Mohandessin. Suitability depends on scar type, skin tone and healing history, and the procedure needs time for recovery and sun protection.
preparation: Discuss cold sores, scarring, tanning and recent medicines. An active infection or poor healing may make treatment inappropriate.
howPerformed: The team examines the texture and skin tone, agrees settings and comfort measures, then treats selected areas with eye protection.
followup: Redness, swelling and crusting can interrupt usual activities. Follow the wound care plan and avoid picking while the skin heals.
risks: Infection, prolonged redness, scarring or pigment changes can occur. Seek advice for worsening pain or areas that fail to heal.
